description: From the causeway, the Isla de Tarifa stands at the southern edge of Europe — the lighthouse and the walls of Santa Catalina's castle against the night, the Strait of Gibraltar breathing between two continents. prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of the Isla de Tarifa, Tarifa, Cádiz, Spain, at night. Night light: restrained lighthouse beam and moonlight, sea reflections, Tangier's lights across the strait, starry sky, 24 degrees C, wind. Main subject centered to survive a 4:5 center crop.
